description: This file defines a custom attribute `VersionAttribute` used to specify version information for interfaces in Orleans, along with the implementation of the attribute, including how it populates grain interface properties.

classes.name: VersionAttribute
classes.description: A sealed attribute class used to assign a version number to Orleans grain interfaces, implementing the `IGrainInterfacePropertiesProviderAttribute` interface.

methods.name: VersionAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute with a specified version.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Implements interface method to populate grain interface properties dictionary with the version information.
